items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Well I always did like Teagarden.

ctx.x: Were there any other trombones you liked when you were young, even if you didn't hear them so much or study? What you mean hear in?
Just to hear him play, yes. Well I always did like Teagarden. Was he ever around here much?
Did you heard him in person or his records? I heard him in person but not in your own.
